Name: MythicPhoenix's Elven Farmer
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
EDIT:  I have updated the mod to work with the new update.  I have NOT updated the Kisekae compatibility files yet.

This mod changes the default farmer sprite into an elf and adds more hairstyles, while still allowing you to wear hats and accessories.

I did make compatibility files for Kisekae.  Please let me know if you notice any errors.

[code][size=5]Install Instructions for Content Patcher[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[/code]
